title: Tyre noise, pressures and run-flat fitment
summary: Feedback on tyres centers on road noise, changing or unclear pressure information, and dissatisfaction around run-flat tyre availability or fitment.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the app for making tyre-pressure checks easier.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain about loud tyre noise, poor tyre quality, and concern about not being able to choose run-flat tyres when no spare is provided.

mixed.summary: One mixed review reports a software problem causing the recommended tyre pressures to keep changing because tyre information is not stored correctly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention tyre blowout avoidance, rust behind the tyres, uncertainty about tyre-pressure sensing, run-flat decisions, tyre availability, extra payment for run-flats, and a changing pressure gauge without enough context to classify sentiment reliably.

limitations: Half of the sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a cleaner sentiment reading for this topic.
The topic mixes several tyre-related subjects including noise, pressure display or sensing, run-flat provision, tyre supply, and nearby rust rather than one single issue.
Examples are limited, so they do not show enough detail to assess broader patterns beyond the sampled fragments.
